import base64,hashlib,json,os,stat,sys
from pathlib import Path
expected={'run-reviewed-service-v2-corrected.py':'6fd1a7c96efc3729173d321398ce0b111f2d5f0cea46df6b0c2d9c2605f3ec07','continue-reviewed-service-v2.py':'fd2546742abdba2d7d568a4af31d481a96084dbcea5829cfbc832430bb5e7ab1'}
raw=sys.stdin.buffer.read(131073);assert len(raw)<=131072
incoming=json.loads(raw);assert set(incoming)==set(expected)
files={name:base64.b64decode(data,validate=True) for name,data in incoming.items()}
assert all(hashlib.sha256(files[name]).hexdigest()==digest for name,digest in expected.items())
os.umask(0o077);p=Path('/home/aicowork/hermes-selinux-trial-20260909-v2')
assert not any(q.is_symlink() for q in (p,*p.parents))
fd=os.open(p,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
try:
 info=os.fstat(fd);assert stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o700 and info.st_uid==os.getuid()
 assert hashlib.sha256((p/'run-reviewed-service-v2.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='3ed9e2e9d8c751b1cb6281648cef4f1691b81fb480442da247b301578af51500'
 assert all(not os.path.lexists(p/name) for name in files)
 for name,data in files.items():
  out=os.open(name,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600,dir_fd=fd)
  with os.fdopen(out,'wb') as stream:stream.write(data);stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
 os.fsync(fd)
 print(json.dumps({'created':expected,'directory_mode':'0700','file_mode':'0600','owner_uid':info.st_uid,'exclusive':True}))
finally:
 os.close(fd)
